The parent component is re-rendering, and React re-renders all children by default even when props stay the same.

The fix depends on which of these is happening:

**Child gets wrapped in `React.memo()`** — prevents re-renders when props haven't changed. Use this first if the props are simple values.

```jsx
export default React.memo(MyChild)
```

**Parent is creating new objects or functions every render** — the props look different each time even though the data is the same. Wrap them with `useMemo` or `useCallback` in the parent:

```jsx
const handleClick = useCallback(() => { ... }, [])
const config = useMemo(() => ({key: value}), [value])
```

**Context is changing** — if your child pulls from a context that updates often, it will re-render regardless of props. Split context into separate providers (one that changes often, one that doesn't) so the static one doesn't trigger unnecessary renders.

If you share your code, I can spot which one is happening.
